entries.title: How to join the library
entries.canonical_answer: Anyone who lives in the community can join the library for free. Bring one document with your name on it, such as an ID card or a school letter. A librarian writes your name in the members' book and gives you a member number.
entries.beginner_answer: Joining is free. Bring one paper with your name on it. The librarian gives you a member number.

entries.title: Joining as a child
entries.canonical_answer: Children under 12 can join with a parent or guardian, who signs the members' book once. The child then gets their own member number.
entries.beginner_answer: If you are under 12, come with a parent or guardian. They sign once. You get your own number.

entries.title: How many books you can borrow
entries.canonical_answer: A member can borrow up to 3 books at a time. Children's picture books do not count toward the limit of 3.
entries.beginner_answer: You can take 3 books at one time. Picture books for children do not count.

entries.title: How long you can keep a book
entries.canonical_answer: A book can be kept for 14 days. If nobody is waiting for it, the loan can be renewed once for another 14 days by asking the librarian.
entries.beginner_answer: You can keep a book for 14 days. You can ask to keep it 14 more days if nobody else wants it.

entries.title: What happens if a book is late
entries.canonical_answer: The library does not charge money for late books. A member with a late book cannot borrow another until the late book is returned.
entries.beginner_answer: There is no fine. But you cannot take a new book until you bring the late one back.

entries.title: If you lose a book
entries.canonical_answer: Tell the librarian as soon as you know. The library may ask you to replace the book or to help with a reading session instead of paying. Never leave a lost book unreported.
entries.beginner_answer: Tell the librarian quickly. You may replace the book or help at a reading session.
safety_notes: Do not hide a lost book; tell the librarian.

entries.title: Opening hours
entries.canonical_answer: The library is open Monday to Friday from 2 pm to 6 pm and on Saturday from 9 am to 1 pm. It is closed on Sunday and on public holidays.
entries.beginner_answer: Open Monday to Friday, 2 pm to 6 pm. Saturday, 9 am to 1 pm. Closed on Sunday.

entries.title: Rules for the reading room
entries.canonical_answer: The reading room is for quiet reading and homework. Please speak softly, keep food and drink outside, and put books back on the trolley, not on the shelf.
entries.beginner_answer: Be quiet. No food or drink inside. Put your books on the trolley when you finish.
